subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Words inscribed on a tomb.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Epitaph"** refers to words inscribed on a tombstone in memory of the person buried there. (समाधिलेख)

 
 
• **Example: **The** epitaph** on her tombstone read, **"Beloved mother, wife, and friend."**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Epitaph**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prologue **(प्रस्तावना): An introductory section of a literary or musical work.

 
 
• **Example:** The prologue of the book provided a backdrop to the main story.
 
 
 
• **Epilogue** (उपसंहार): A section at the end of a book or play that serves as a comment on or a conclusion to what has happened.
 
 
• **Example:** The epilogue revealed the fate of the main characters years after the main events of the story.
 
 
 
• **Post-script** (परिशिष्ट): An additional remark at the end of a letter, after the signature.
 
 
• **Example:** In her post-script, she asked if he could send her the book they discussed.
